criteria_results.criterion: AC-1 through AC-5 have passing unit/integration tests
criteria_results.evidence: Phase output documents 5 acceptance criteria fully implemented with mapped test coverage: AC-1 (MagicByteValidator, 7 tests), AC-2 (DimensionValidator, 9 tests), AC-3 (S3Adapter + ProfileImageService + Controller, 10+9+13 tests), AC-4 (same-key overwrite + row-lock concurrency, 2 dedicated tests), AC-5 (idempotent delete, 3 dedicated tests). All findings marked RESOLVED.

Phase output reports 48 unit/feature tests (7 MagicByte, 9 Dimension, 10 S3Adapter, 9 ProfileImageService, 13 ProfileImageController) covering 781 lines of production code. Estimated coverage on changed lines: >=85%. Coverage breakdown per component: Controller 100%, S3Adapter 97.96%, Service 95.83%, validators 82-87%. All critical paths tested: file validation (magic bytes, size boundary), S3 upload/delete, DB linkage, presigned URLs, auth checks, validation errors, S3 errors, concurrency lock.

All 17 artifacts are new (6 production PHP + 1 migration + 5 test files + 3 supporting files: composer.json, phpunit.xml, tests/bootstrap.php). Zero impact on existing code per ARCH-COMPLIANCE finding. No existing tests need updating.

criteria_results.criterion: Every test file maps to an AC (K-3 check)
criteria_results.evidence: Phase output provides explicit K-3 mappings via AC-1-MAP through AC-5-MAP findings: AC-1 → MagicByteValidator + 7 tests; AC-2 → DimensionValidator + 9 tests; AC-3 → S3Adapter + ProfileImageService + Controller + 32 tests; AC-4 → ProfileImageService same-key overwrite + row-lock + 2 tests; AC-5 → ProfileImageService delete + Controller destroy + 3 tests. All test files structurally valid PHPUnit classes with correct namespaces.

criteria_results.criterion: All assertions run, no skipped tests
criteria_results.evidence: Phase output TEST-SUITE finding: '48 unit/feature tests... No @-suppression, no sleep retries.' Each test verifies one behavior with >=2 assertions. No test skips or @skip annotations reported. TEST-ENV finding confirms full execution environment via 'composer install && vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-text'.

key_decisions_implemented: Magic byte validation (not MIME type) for file format security
S3Adapter presigned URLs (3600s TTL, on-demand generation)
Same-key overwrite strategy with orphan logging
Idempotent DELETE (null DB, attempt S3 delete)
SELECT FOR UPDATE row lock for concurrent upload control

handshake_notes: Phase 5 (Software Engineer) complete and validated. All acceptance criteria implemented with comprehensive test coverage. Zero pre-existing failures. Ready for Phase 6 (QA Engineer) validation gate.
